summary: Allocations between documents of different contacts are rejected
details:
Xero is beginning to require (notice of 2026-10-08) a credit note, prepayment or overpayment to belong to the same contact as the invoice or bill it is allocated to. Allocation requests that create a new contact mismatch return a validation error (HTTP 400). The notice is dated 2026-10-08 and gives no separate enforcement date.

Before calling PUT /CreditNotes/{CreditNoteID}/Allocations, /Prepayments/{PrepaymentID}/Allocations or /Overpayments/{OverpaymentID}/Allocations, check that Contact.ContactID is the same on the source document and on the target invoice or bill. On a validation error, show the user the mismatch instead of retrying, because the unchanged request keeps failing.
